groveland_ca.name: Groveland
groveland_ca.obs_note: No official station near Groveland. The nearest is the Mount Elizabeth fire-weather station, 15 miles away and 2,100 ft higher.

alerts.headline: Heat Advisory issued October 2 at 10:00AM PDT until October 7 at 10:00PM PDT by NWS Sacramento CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures of 94 to 100 degrees expected and low
temperatures in the mid 60s to low 70s, with widespread Moderate
HeatRisk and areas of Major HeatRisk.

* WHERE...Sacramento and northern San Joaquin valleys, Delta and
Carquinez Strait, and foothills.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Saturday to 10 PM PDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures may cause heat illnesses, especially to
anyone without effective cooling and/or adequate hydration.
